fact: Failure to serve a penalty during a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article B1.9.6b.iii of the FIA F1 Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. The driver of car 63 entered the pit lane to perform a pit stop, but the team did not carry out the required penalty procedure, meaning the penalty was effectively not served. A drive through penalty is imposed because there was no attempt to serve the original time penalty. This is different to the situation where, for example, a person accidentally touches the car during the time penalty period but no actual work is carried out on the car and the penalty time expires before work commences.
stewards: having received a report from the Race Director
but the team did not carry out the required penalty procedure
title: Doc 93 Infringement Car 63 Failing To Serve Time Penalty Correctly
